title: Cross-Platform Execution Fabric — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Coordinates compatible programs across PCs, workstations, servers, and edge devices. A proposed fabric that runs programs across whatever hardware is available — PCs, workstations, servers, edge devices — matching each program to compatible platforms, moving data securely between them, and presenting one coherent execution environment to the user.
